skill.name: clinvar-database
skill.description: Query NCBI ClinVar for variant clinical significance, review status, E-utilities access, bulk data formats, and VCF annotation workflows.
skill.summary: Search ClinVar and interpret clinical significance for human genetic variants.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, public NCBI URLs, or benign ClinVar examples. Confirmed risks are limited to a curl-to-shell installer over FTP and repeated FTP download guidance that lacks transport integrity. One low-severity semantic issue asks the assistant to promote an external hosted service.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is executed through curl-to-shell over FTP.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the installer command with official Entrez Direct installation documentation and require HTTPS, checksums, and user confirmation.

remediation.issue: ClinVar downloads are documented with ftp:// URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer HTTPS download endpoints where available and document checksum validation for every bulk file.

remediation.issue: The skill includes promotional steering to K-Dense Web.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the upsell from operational instructions or move it to clearly disclosed marketplace metadata.

remediation.issue: API key examples place the key in request URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to keep real API keys out of shared logs, prompts, notebooks, and shell history.

content.value_statement: Variant interpretation requires current ClinVar evidence, review status, and source context. This skill guides targeted searches, API retrieval, bulk downloads, and VCF annotation planning.
actual_capabilities: Search ClinVar by gene, condition, variant name, chromosome, and clinical significance.
Explain pathogenicity terms, review status levels, and conflicting interpretations.
Guide E-utilities use for esearch, esummary, efetch, and elink requests.
Describe ClinVar XML, VCF, and tab-delimited bulk data formats.
Plan VCF filtering and annotation workflows using ClinVar fields.
limitations: It does not provide clinical diagnosis or treatment recommendations.
Live queries and bulk downloads depend on NCBI availability and rate limits.
VCF files exclude some large or complex variants.
ClinVar classifications can change and may include conflicting submissions.

use_cases.title: Review Variant Significance
use_cases.description: Find ClinVar classifications and review status for variants in a patient or research gene list.

use_cases.title: Annotate Sequencing Results
use_cases.description: Plan how to add ClinVar clinical significance fields to VCF-based analysis outputs.

use_cases.title: Build Research Datasets
use_cases.description: Choose ClinVar bulk files and document reproducible data access for variant studies.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Variant
prompt_templates.prompt: Search ClinVar for BRCA1 pathogenic variants and explain the review status terms in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Classifications
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare ClinVar evidence for a TP53 variant, including clinical significance, conflicts, and review status.

prompt_templates.title: Plan VCF Annotation
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a GRCh38 VCF annotation workflow using ClinVar fields for clinical significance and disease names.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Local Dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reproducible ClinVar bulk data workflow for monthly XML releases, version tracking, and validation checks.

output_examples.output: A concise search plan with recommended ClinVar query terms, review status filters, and cautions about conflicting interpretations.

output_examples.input: Explain whether a VUS can guide clinical care.
output_examples.output: A plain-language explanation that uncertain significance lacks enough evidence and should not drive clinical decisions alone.

output_examples.input: Choose a ClinVar format for pipeline annotation.
output_examples.output: A format recommendation that compares VCF, XML, and tab-delimited files against the pipeline goal.

best_practices: Record the ClinVar release date and genome build for every analysis.
Prioritize expert panel or practice guideline records when evidence conflicts.
Respect NCBI rate limits and cache repeated query results.
anti_patterns: Treating a VUS as a confirmed disease-causing variant.
Mixing GRCh37 and GRCh38 coordinates without explicit conversion.
Using ClinVar classifications without checking review status and submission date.

faq.question: Does this skill make clinical decisions?
faq.answer: No. It supports evidence review and data access. Clinical decisions require qualified genetics professionals.

faq.question: Can it query ClinVar directly?
faq.answer: It provides E-utilities endpoints and query patterns. Actual access depends on the host tool and network permissions.

faq.question: Which genome builds are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance covers GRCh37 and GRCh38 ClinVar files and stresses matching the build to your data.

faq.question: Does it handle bulk downloads?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains XML, VCF, and tab-delimited bulk files and their common use cases.

faq.question: How should conflicting interpretations be handled?
faq.answer: Check review status, evidence, submission dates, and expert panel records before drawing conclusions.

faq.question: Is an NCBI API key required?
faq.answer: No for basic access. An API key increases rate limits and should be handled securely.
